<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Legal request volume determines the scale of benefit from Now Assist triage and routing capabilities. Higher request volumes mean greater time savings for legal operations teams using AI-assisted intake and classification.]]></ai_justification><check_name>Legal Request Volume</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function() {
    try {
        var ga = new GlideAggregate("sn_lg_ops_request");
        ga.addAggregate("COUNT");
        ga.query();
        var c = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")) : 0;
        if (c >= 100) {
            return { status: "ready", actualValue: c + " requests", finding: c + " legal requests found. Now Assist LSD has sufficient request volume for AI-assisted legal triage." };
        } else if (c > 0) {
            return { status: "needs_attention", actualValue: c + " requests", finding: c + " legal requests found (target: 100+). Limited volume reduces Now Assist LSD AI accuracy." };
        } else {
            return { status: "value_blocker", actualValue: "0 requests", finding: "No legal requests found. Now Assist LSD requires request data for AI-assisted legal triage." };
        }
    } catch(e) {
        return { status: "verification_needed", actualValue: "Check failed", finding: "Script execution error: " + e.message };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>LSD</module><number>CHK0002782</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Ensure legal requests are being submitted through the Legal Service Delivery module.</remediation_guidance><sys_class_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 18:12:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>1ee38131cf2d0fd48935fb251d851cfd</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Legal Request Volume</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform" source="x_snc_airop">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_scope><sys_update_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition_1ee38131cf2d0fd48935fb251d851cfd</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 18:12:32</sys_updated_on></x_snc_airop_check_definition></record_update>
